description: Defines the API and data structures for managing linear ranges, including functions for calculating values, indices, and handling groups of ranges, primarily used for voltage regulation or similar applications.

methods.name: linear_range_values_count
methods.description: Returns the number of values representable in a given linear range.

methods.name: linear_range_group_values_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of values across a group of linear ranges.

methods.name: linear_range_get_max_value
methods.description: Calculates the maximum value that can be represented by a linear range.

methods.name: linear_range_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value corresponding to a specific index within a linear range.

methods.name: linear_range_group_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific index across a group of linear ranges.

methods.name: linear_range_get_index
methods.description: Finds the index corresponding to a specific value within a linear range, handling out-of-range values.

methods.name: linear_range_group_get_index
methods.description: Finds the index for a value considering multiple linear ranges.

methods.name: linear_range_get_win_index
methods.description: Finds an index within a range window, considering the linear range.

methods.name: linear_range_group_get_win_index
methods.description: Finds an index within a window across multiple linear ranges.
